name: nifty-codex
description: Codex adapter for Nifty task-card workflows with policy-gateway enforcement.

interface.shortDescription: Work Nifty task cards through Codex.
interface.longDescription: Nifty Codex packages the Nifty MCP adapter, task-card operating guidance, and advisory local hooks. Codex can request Nifty actions, while sensitive writes are routed through the configured policy gateway for authoritative company-rule enforcement.
defaultPrompt: Open my active Nifty task and hydrate full context.
Prepare this Nifty card for Dev Review with evidence.
List Nifty work ready for implementation.
